title: Hayati Pro Max Rainbow Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Rainbow delivers a vibrant mix of sweet and tangy fruit flavours inspired by chewy rainbow confectionery. With a medley of berry and citrus notes layered together, this vape captures the playful balance of sugary sharpness and juicy depth that defines classic mixed fruit sweets. Formulated with nicotine salts for quicker absorption and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG blend provides consistently clear flavour and discreet vapour. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
